_about: The protein buff (the owner, 2026-10-26: "aiming speed -15%", on top of what it does; srp-026g/docs/notes/booster-buffs.md). Anomalous Force Protein (weight_booster, a booster: it works carried, no timed effect) keeps its default modification 1124 (weight limit +5 kg) and gets a second one: a new modification 1085, aim_time_modifier (index 49: scope-in 0x2E1B50 and scope-out 0x2E1BF0 take the weapon's aim_time x max(0, 1 + the sum)) -0.15, made like 1084 (the rolled aim time -10 %, card line 102 "Aiming speed", lower is better) with drop_weight 0, so it never rolls; added at the end of the table (after rations-stamina-1's 1165). The card shows both: "Weight limit: +5kg" and "Aiming speed: -15%".
